$comment: Generated by scripts/contracts.py from specs/schema/*.json. Do not edit.

take_over.description: Take shared targets from the zones that drive them.

ActivityParams.description: Silence uses the level without gain.

Address.description: Where the target's elements are on the provider: a range of LEDs, or Hue entertainment channels.

Ambient.description: The ambient light shown when audio reactiveness is off, or in auto after silence.

ApplyResult.description: What an apply did in one zone.

scene.description: The id of the scene the zone now has active.

roles.description: Each bound role of the applied scene: the surface it went to.

skipped.description: Roles no surface of the zone could take.

index.description: The surface index in its frames.

scene.description: The scene id whose layers it renders.

beat_offset_ms.description: Its zone's beat timing offset: beats fire earlier when positive.

album_colors.description: Its zone takes colours from the album art.

device.description: default (follows the default output), an output name (its loopback), or in:<input name>.

app.description: An app's executable name, lowercase; empty for none (Windows only in v1).

AudioVisualizerParams.description: The audio-visualizer effect's parameters: today's segment fields, unchanged. threshold and ceiling show the widest range here; the thresholds rule applies the limits of the trigger.

Auth.description: For clients without the session cookie: the first message.

request_id.description: Random, shown to the client's user.

BackupManifest.description: folo-backup.json, the manifest of a backup archive (ADR-0038 D25).

format.description: 1; a newer format is refused with 422 incompatible.

schema_version.description: The documents' schema_version; a newer one than the node reads is refused with 422 incompatible.

files.description: path: SHA-256 (hex) of every other file in the archive.

phase.description: Share of the current beat gone by.

bar_beat.description: Beat of the bar, 0 for the first.

BlackBars.description: How the capture agent finds the black bars (letterbox and pillarbox) around the picture.

preset.description: auto: detect them. off: none. 21:9 and 4:3: the bars of a picture of that shape, forced.

mode.description: default: every side. letterbox: top and bottom only, ignoring subtitles. osd: finds the horizontal bars first, to look past overlays.

threshold.description: How dark a pixel counts as black, as a share of full scale.

BlurParams.description: The blur post-processing effect: a box blur, in cells on each side.

BrightnessParams.description: The brightness post-processing effect: saturation around each cell's luma, then a multiplier.

white.description: How RGBW and RGB+CCT targets get their white channel.

Capabilities.description: What a target can do: as discovered from its provider, and the user's overrides (docs/architecture/capabilities.md).

CapabilityOverrides.description: Only the fields the user changed; the others come from the discovered descriptor.

CaptureHello.description: The capture agent's handshake payload on the capture link (ADR-0037 D2). It is JSON in the first WebSocket text message, on the loopback link only.

token.description: The node's launch token for its capture agent.

CaptureMethod.description: Node -> capture agent, on the capture link.

CaptureNotificationMethod.description: Capture agent -> node, on the capture link.

CaptureSecrets.description: What the capture agent's portal session needs to be restored without asking again (docs/decisions/ADR-0037-display-capture-agent.md D14). Single use: the node replaces it after every start. Absent (not defaulted) so existing documents clamp to the same bytes.

restore_token.description: Absent until the portal has given one.

CaptureStartParams.description: Starts capturing one screen (ADR-0037 D3, D5). The agent delivers frames that fit width x height in the screen's aspect ratio, at most rate_hz a second.

restore_token.description: Linux: the portal's restore token from secrets.json, when there is one.

CaptureStatusParams.description: The capture agent's state, sent at least once a second and when it changes (its heartbeat). The node removes restore_token before it shows the status to clients (live.json's ScreenStatus).

backend.description: dda, wgc, gdi, portal, synthetic or replay; empty while off.

screen.description: The screen being captured; empty while off.

hdr.description: The screen runs in HDR and is tone-mapped.

protected.description: Protected content is on screen and can't be captured.

restore_token.description: Linux: the portal's new restore token, to keep in secrets.json.

message.description: Why it is paused or in error.

settings_uri.description: Where the user can allow capture, when the operating system's privacy setting refuses it: an ms-settings: link.

CaptureWelcome.description: The node's handshake payload on the capture link.

CellsRegion.description: Absolute cells start-end (inclusive) of a strip.

key_hash.description: The client key's hash; the key itself is never stored.

ClientsDocument.title: ClientsDocument
ClientsDocument.description: clients.json: client keys, stored hashed (docs/specs/config-model.md, docs/specs/pairing-and-connect.md).

DisplayGeometry.description: Reserved for projection mapping: validated but never executed in v1 (docs/architecture/projection-mapping-groundwork.md).

mask.description: A polygon in the rectangle's (u, v) coordinates, 0-1; empty for none.

inputs.description: Inputs it reads: audio, beat, media, screen, generator.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema of its parameters; the UI's inspector is built from it.

code.description: A machine code, for example not_found.

id.description: The job's id; for kind library, the pack's id, empty after a restore (ADR-0038).

Gamut.description: Primaries as CIE xy; the defaults are sRGB's.

Geometry.description: Where a target's elements are, by kind. It follows the target's kind.

origin.description: Hyperion rejects an origin longer than 20 characters.

Id.description: An id of 1-64 characters. Missing, empty or duplicate ids get a new one (8 lowercase hex characters).

Identity.description: The node's static X25519 key pair, base64url (docs/specs/pairing-and-connect.md#identity).

capabilities.description: Optional features, for example hue or screen.

InputList.description: The inputs available on a source.

media.description: Whether now playing can be read on this source.

InputStatus.description: The audio input: format, packets/s, delay, glitches, meters, gain.

peaks_db.description: Falling peak meters of the first two channels, dBFS.

uses.description: More than 1 only for handover invites.

IssuedClient.description: Shown once: the key isn't stored.

ItemType.description: A pack item type, as its folder is named.

verification_code.description: 6 digits, also shown on the source.

params.description: The effect's parameters, clamped with its parameter schema when the effect is known.

audio-visualizer.name: Audio visualizer
audio-visualizer.description: A frequency band of the audio, shaped and smoothed, in one of ten modes.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Scales the colours below it, and their saturation around their luma.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.description: Copies one half of what is below it, reversed, onto the other half.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: Averages each cell of what is below it with its neighbours.

trail.name: Trail
trail.description: An afterglow: what is below it fades out instead of going dark at once.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The picture of a captured screen, without its black bars, as a canvas.

surface.description: The surface the layers draw on (ADR-0035 D4).

layers.description: Layer id: [band level dB, value 0-1, recent average dB].

LevelsParams.description: The levels of a surface's layers (ADR-0035 D6).

layers.description: Layer id: [band level dB, value 0-1, recent average dB].

LibraryItem.description: An item of an installed pack, for the gallery.

hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the item's file, as provenance records it.

preview.description: The preview's path under /library/packs/{pack}/previews/, or empty.

item.description: The item, as clamped (pack.json's item of this type).

LineGeometry.description: Elements spaced evenly along a path, or at explicit positions (Hue gradient channels).

LiveServerMessage.description: {type, data}. Binary topics (spectrum, surface, target) arrive as frames.

enabled.description: Run a local source alongside the controller (off in Docker).

source.description: node, or a source id or worker.

LookItem.description: One layer's full recipe: an effect, its parameters, and optional reaction and palette items (author/pack:item).

hints.description: Presentation hints for clients (tempo, preview, group, source); the node and the engines ignore them.

Macro.description: A knob that drives parameters of several layers.

ManualRange.description: Cells of the surface onto elements of the target, optionally reversed.

art.description: Album art id, 0 without art. Clients add it to the art URL to bust caches.

colors.description: Up to five colours picked from the art.

MirrorParams.description: The mirror post-processing effect: the half it keeps is copied, reversed, onto the other.

NodeOverride.description: A setting given by a FOLO_* variable or a flag (docs/architecture/control-plane.md#settings-layering).

setting.description: The setting's path in node.toml, for example listen.port.

name.description: The variable or the flag, for example FOLO_LISTEN_PORT or --port.

value.description: The value it gives the setting.

NodeSettings.title: NodeSettings
NodeSettings.description: node.toml's settings, as they look after parsing. Overridable by FOLO_* variables and CLI flags (docs/architecture/control-plane.md#settings-layering).

running.description: Whether a node runs on this home: always true from the API, false when `folo status` reports from the files.

id.description: The node id (docs/specs/pairing-and-connect.md#identity); empty until the node first ran.

launch.description: managed: started by the desktop app.

mode.description: The launch that chose the folders (docs/architecture/control-plane.md#folders): custom for --home or FOLO_HOME.

listen.description: The address and port the node listens on, or would listen on.

overrides.description: The deployment overrides, with their sources.

OnOff.description: How on/off targets switch: a threshold with hysteresis and a minimum interval between changes.

builtin.description: folo/core, folo/genres and folo/effects ship with the node and can't be removed.

editable.description: A local pack (author local), whose items can be written.

hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the pack's canonical .folopack (ADR-0038 D9).

PackManifest.title: PackManifest
PackManifest.description: folo-pack.json, the manifest of a .folopack, and the items packs contain (docs/specs/pack-format.md, docs/architecture/content.md). Items are clamped like documents; a pack that fails structural validation is rejected as a whole.

files.description: path: sha256 (hex) of every file in the pack.

categories.description: Groups of the gallery, merged by id across packs (ADR-0038 D17).

owner.description: In the source role, the owner controller's id; empty while unpaired and in the controller role.

sources.description: In the controller role, the paired sources besides the local one.

PaletteColor.description: #RRGGBB, or a white stop in kelvin such as 2700K.

hints.description: Presentation hints for clients (tempo, preview, group, source); the node and the engines ignore them.

Plane.description: A rectangle in a zone: an origin corner and the u (width) and v (height) edge vectors.

Provenance.description: Where an applied scene came from (ADR-0038 D11).

hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the item's file as applied; absent when unknown.

ProvidersDocument.title: ProvidersDocument
ProvidersDocument.description: providers.json: provider instances and their settings (docs/specs/config-model.md, docs/integrations/).

levels.description: The surface indices whose layers' levels the source sends as levels notifications (ADR-0035 D6).

height.description: Canvases are capped at 128 x 72 on the network.

token.description: The node's launch token for its own effect engine, on the loopback link only.

ReactionItem.description: How a layer responds to audio: the band, trigger and response fields of the audio-visualizer parameters.

hints.description: Presentation hints for clients (tempo, preview, group, source); the node and the engines ignore them.

params.description: A subset of the audio-visualizer parameters, clamped when a look or layer uses it.

RectRegion.description: A rectangle of a canvas, 0-1 of its width and height.

Ref.description: The id of another entity; empty for none.

ReferenceSize.description: The reference object's width and height, metres (a TV's screen).

Region.description: Where a layer sits on its surface.

RelativeRegion.description: start-end along a strip, 0-1 of its length. snap: cover takes every cell the range touches; nearest rounds both ends to the nearest cell, halves up, as the studio's built-in builders do (docs/architecture/pipeline.md, ADR-0038 D14).

applied.description: Settings and documents applied while running.

restart_required.description: Changed settings that take effect after a restart.

allowed_hosts.description: Host names and addresses accepted by the Host check, besides the loopback names.

RoleBinding.description: The surfaces a user chose for a scene's roles in a zone.

scene.description: The scene's reference as resolved: author/pack:item, or a scene id of this document.

layers_by_role.description: Surface role (strip.main, canvas.room, ...): its layers, bottom first.

roles.description: Role: surface id, overriding the automatic match and remembered for this scene and zone; an empty string returns the role to automatic (ADR-0038 D12, D13).

keep_changes.description: Merge into the zone's active scene, keeping what the user changed since it was applied (ADR-0038 D15).

SceneItem.description: A scene in a pack. It never contains addresses or keys.

hints.description: Presentation hints for clients (tempo, preview, group, source); the node and the engines ignore them.

led_count.description: The strip length its cells regions were made for, so they can be scaled to another; 0 when it has none.

fallbacks.description: Role: the role to use when the zone has no surface for it.

SchemaVersion.description: The document format version. A newer one than the reader knows is a structural error.

width.description: In pixels; 0 while it isn't known (the Linux portal entry, before the user has chosen a screen).

height.description: In pixels; 0 while it isn't known.

ScreenBars.description: The black bars found around the picture, each as a share (0-1) of the frame's height (top, bottom) or width (left, right).

ScreenFrameHeader.description: Header of a screen frame (FOLC), little-endian, on the loopback links only; the payload follows: width x height x 3 bytes of rgb8, row-major (ADR-0037 D4).

profile.description: video: films and shows. game: ignores the screen's edges (HUDs) and adopts changes faster. It sets how the capture agent finds black bars.

ScreenParams.description: The screen effect: what the capture agent's frames show, cropped, sampled onto the layer's region of a canvas, coloured and smoothed. On a strip it draws nothing.

mode.description: area: the whole picture. edge: the picture's border, spread inward.

edge_depth.description: How deep the border reaches into the picture in edge mode, as a share of its width and height.

margins.description: The shares of the picture to leave out at each side, after the black bars.

smoothing.description: The time constant of the smoothing, ms; 0 shows each frame as it is.

bars.description: follow: leave out the black bars the capture agent found. ignore: use the whole picture.

ScreenStatus.description: The screen capture: what the capture agent last reported, without the restore token. Never carries frames or anything drawn from them (ADR-0037 D9). unavailable: capture is wanted but no agent can run (no user session, or the desktop app hasn't started it); message says why.

backend.description: dda, wgc, gdi, portal, synthetic or replay; empty while off.

screen.description: The screen being captured; empty while off.

protected.description: Protected content is on screen and can't be captured.

settings_uri.description: An ms-settings: link to the Windows privacy setting.

ScreensListResult.description: The answer to screens.list: the screens the agent can capture (api.json's Screen).

SecretsDocument.title: SecretsDocument
SecretsDocument.description: secrets.json: identity keys and provider credentials. Owner-only permissions; never exported or returned by the API (docs/specs/config-model.md, docs/architecture/security.md).

ServerId.description: Changes when the controller starts, so clients notice a restart.

ShowDocument.title: ShowDocument
ShowDocument.description: show.json: the active scene per zone, the scenes with their layers, and the default scene (docs/specs/config-model.md, docs/architecture/content.md).

default_scene.description: What Reset all applies: a pack item (author/pack:item), a built-in id (fx:*, genre:*) resolved through the alias table, or a bare id (a scene of this document, else an item of local/my-presets); empty for folo/core:default (ADR-0038 D19, D21).

bindings.description: Remembered role overrides per zone and scene (ADR-0038 D13).

ShowResetRequest.description: Reset all: the zones to reset; empty for every zone (ADR-0038 D21).

SignalFrameHeader.description: Header of a signal frame (FOLG), little-endian; count float32 values follow.

role.description: This controller's relation to the source.

public_key.description: The source's static X25519 key, base64url.

SourcesDocument.title: SourcesDocument
SourcesDocument.description: sources.json: paired sources, their role, assigned surfaces and inputs (docs/specs/config-model.md, docs/architecture/control-plane.md).

Span.description: A run of cells or elements.

State.description: Everything a UI needs to start, in one call.

StudioV1.title: StudioV1
StudioV1.description: Today's studio.json (version 1), as sanitize_config() in folo_source/legacy/v1.py makes it. Version 1 keeps its own, looser rules (docs/specs/config-model.md#clamping-rules): this schema records its limits and defaults for the migration (RB-05), and the v1 module of folo-protocol ports the rules. threshold and ceiling show the widest range; the trigger picks the limits.

topics.description: Topic: the frame index its binary frames carry (absent for JSON topics).

SurfaceFrameHeader.description: Header of a surface frame (FOLS), little-endian; the payload follows: width x height x channels x bytes per channel, row-major.

SurfaceResolution.description: Cells. A strip is width x 1, up to 2000 cells.

target.description: A target id; empty for all of the zone's targets.

Topic.description: status, or a topic about one source, zone, surface or target.

TrailParams.description: The trail post-processing effect: an afterglow fading with this time constant, in ms.

mode.description: What happens when an update is found.

Vec3.description: A position or vector in a zone, metres: x right, y forward, z up.

mesh.description: Mesh warp: control points in (u, v), row-major.

verification_code.description: For join requests: 6 digits shown on both sides.

pid.description: Its process id; 0 while it isn't running.

restarts.description: How often it was started again since the node started.

active.description: Whether the zone drives its targets. At most one active zone drives a target (docs/architecture/spatial-model.md#zone-activation-rules).

conflicts.description: Active zones that share targets with it; activating asks before taking them over.

ZoneTemplateItem.description: A target layout without provider bindings, addresses or keys.

hints.description: Presentation hints for clients (tempo, preview, group, source); the node and the engines ignore them.

ZonesDocument.title: ZonesDocument
ZonesDocument.description: zones.json: zones, targets, surfaces and mappings (docs/specs/config-model.md, docs/architecture/spatial-model.md).
